data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open the Book form, enter origin and destination, pick dates, click Find flights, optionally pick a fare) and names nearly all the right parameters. It omits trip_type as a parameter and adds the pay_with_miles option, and the date and traveler steps are somewhat vague, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
